hook: Two coal plants burn the same coal. One sends a gray plume and 40,000 metric tons of sulfur dioxide a year out of its stack. The other sends out a thin white plume of steam and 2,000 metric tons. The difference is a tower of limestone spray and a set of charged metal plates, put there because a law required the cut.

prereq.q: Which pollutant is released mainly by burning coal?
prereq.why: Sulfur in coal becomes SO2 when it burns.

prereq.q: What two ingredients react in sunlight to form photochemical smog?
prereq.why: NOx and VOCs in sunlight make ground-level ozone.

figure.caption: Each control device removes particular pollutants. Match the device to the pollutant, and know where it sits.

chain.cause: A law or rule sets a limit on a pollutant
chain.effect: a plant or carmaker must cut its emissions

chain.cause: They choose a method: cleaner fuel before burning, better burning, or a device after burning
chain.effect: the pollutant is prevented, changed, or captured

chain.cause: Scrubbers capture SO2, precipitators and baghouses capture particles, catalytic converters change CO, NOx and hydrocarbons
chain.effect: less of each pollutant leaves the stack or tailpipe

chain.cause: Less SO2, NOx, VOCs and particles in the air
chain.effect: less smog, fewer acid-forming gases and fewer lung and heart problems

ideas: Coal plants: scrubbers (wet or dry, often limestone) remove SO2; electrostatic precipitators and baghouse filters remove particles. Low-sulfur coal and fluidized bed combustion also cut SO2; cooler burning cuts NOx.
Cars: catalytic converters turn CO into CO2, NOx into N2, and hydrocarbons into CO2 and water. Vapor recovery nozzles capture gasoline vapor (VOCs) at the pump, not exhaust.
Policies: emission limits, cap-and-trade permits, fuel standards, tax credits for clean energy, and transit that cuts driving. A policy is a rule; a device is a technology.
None of these devices removes CO2. Cutting CO2 means burning less fossil fuel.

misconception.wrong: Vapor recovery nozzles at gas pumps clean the car's exhaust.
misconception.right: Vapor recovery nozzles capture gasoline vapor (VOCs) pushed out of the tank while it fills. Exhaust is cleaned by the catalytic converter.

summary: Air pollutants are cut by using cleaner fuel, burning it better, or capturing pollutants after burning. Scrubbers remove SO2; electrostatic precipitators and baghouse filters remove particles; catalytic converters change CO, NOx and hydrocarbons into less harmful gases; vapor recovery nozzles capture gasoline vapor. Laws such as emission caps and cap-and-trade programs make these cuts happen. None of the devices removes CO2.
